intent: Convert the VCF to PLINK binary format so that every sample keeps the name it has in the VCF as its ID, because the phenotype and covariate tables are keyed by those names.
silent_error: plink 1.9 --vcf, without --double-id or --const-fid, parses every VCF sample name as <FID>_<IID> and splits it at the first underscore: NA12878_rep1 becomes family NA12878 / individual rep1. The .fam file no longer contains the VCF sample names, the same IID (rep1, rep2) now appears under three different families, and any later join on the sample name (phenotype, covariates, --keep) silently fails to match or mixes up samples. The log says nothing; exit 0. plink2 does not split, so the two versions also disagree. --double-id keeps FID = IID = VCF sample name (plink 1.9 --vcf documentation: --double-id, --id-delim, default delimiter '_').
